name: Homunculus
summary: A tiny construct servant with a poisonous bite, bonded telepathically to its creator.

traits.name: Telepathic Bond
traits.text: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}. *Failure:* The target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the end of the homunculus's next turn. *Failure by 5 or More:* The target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition for 1 minute. While {ref:condition/poisoned}, the target has the {ref:condition/unconscious} condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.
